semantics.scope: Changes first reflected in immutable INDEX:80 Registry releases.
semantics.date_rule: observed_on is the Registry proof-confirmation observation date, not necessarily the real-world effective date of the underlying fact.
semantics.addition_rule: added_to_index means added to INDEX:80, not project/person launch or creation.
semantics.removal_rule: removed_from_public_index is neutral and does not imply that an entity ceased operating.
semantics.privacy_rename_rule: privacy_renamed means a People profile was renamed at the subject's request; the former name and address are intentionally withheld.
semantics.public_candidate_rule: Only the approved conservative candidate fields are public; broader editorial maintenance remains audit-only.
